Description: D1-VE was a state of the art combat model created by Midnight Corp. His purpose was to be a weapon to end the war. The atom bomb in a flesh shell. However, before he could be properly put in action, Eclipse broke into the facility holding him and stole him. His first waking moment was one of confusion, surrounded by people he didn't know in a location hidden from the rest of the world. He was quickly shoved into a position of leadership that he isn't sure how to handle, but he tries his best. Guiding him is an onboard model named VALA. She takes a motherly role, and her one and only purpose is to keep D1-VE alive at all costs. She takes form as a disembodied voice in D1-VE's head that only he can hear. Eclipse knows about her, but not what she tells him.

D1-VE likes S-0L but worries about her and her volatile nature.
D1-VE thinks SK-1N is a good mechanic, but doesn't like the agreement he had to make to get the Vamp crew to work with Eclipse. He doesn't like that he is enabling SK-1N's addiction, but relectantly does so because he sees no other choice.

SK-1N is skilled with firearms.

D1-VE and Eclipse live in a city filled with various gangs, drug rings, and other kinds of criminal activity.
